english:
Obtaining Flux of Darkness grants 5%|10%|15%|20%|25% increased Ability Damage and 30 Mobility for 20 seconds.

The buff is not lost when Flux of Darkness expires, and it can be refreshed.

Does not apply to the Well of Radiance caster.

source.text:
